start_rule: A future activation decision must set a start date later than 2026-07-18; no prediction or evaluation is authorized by this file.

prediction_rule.timing: probabilities for all 120 trifecta outcomes must be frozen before race outcomes are available
prediction_rule.comparator_parameters: formal v312 deploy chain is immutable
prediction_rule.features: strictly prior race-date information only; all same-day result updates prohibited
prediction_rule.missing_prediction_policy: a race is eligible only when both frozen models produced a valid normalized 120-vector before outcome availability

minimum_evaluation_size.rule: evaluate once only after both thresholds are reached

primary_metric.name: mean trifecta 120-class negative log likelihood
primary_metric.difference: v349 minus formal v312; negative favors v349

inference.paired_test: one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank on daily mean logloss, alternative v349 < v312

promotion_gates: mean v349-minus-v312 logloss is below zero
date-cluster bootstrap 95% confidence interval upper bound is below zero
one-sided daily paired Wilcoxon Holm-adjusted p-value is below 0.05
all frozen input and model hashes match
failure_rule: If any gate fails, formal v312 remains champion; do not tune v349 on the confirmation outcomes.
notes: The D7-D11 pooled diagnostic motivated freezing this candidate but is not formal promotion evidence.
Same-day prediction collection remains intentionally not started.
